items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I borrowed a couple of books by jazz players. One of them was Mezz Mezzrow.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know the Roosevelt Ballroom.

Is it in New Orleans? Somewhere, on top of some hotel... I’d have my radio on underneath the covers, listening to it, and they played Dixieland. That was when I was about in the seventh grade—seventh and eighth grade. I would go to the junior high school library, and I borrowed a couple of books by jazz players. One of them was Mezz Mezzrow. They were talking about smoking marijuana and stuff, but they didn’t say that. I couldn’t figure out what they were talking about. But that’s when I started listening to…
